scientific_integrity: The prime-valuation and multiplicative-order proof is symbolic. The decimal frequency and least-period calculations are exact and reproducible. Computational checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two nonzero digits and exact base-power cutoffs; no higher-weight or arbitrary-cutoff estimates. Earlier digit-multiset equivalence-class work may contain unstated equivalent implications; the 1985 mathematical OCR is imperfect.
title: Exact two-nonzero-digit Niven counts and a 48-phase decimal law
